summary: Phase 17: Smart Subscription Management Card - Backend testing completed. Core functionality working: billing status endpoint returns correct states, certificates persist after tier lapse, resume endpoint validates correctly. Found one logic issue with LAPSED state detection for manually-upgraded users.

medium_priority_bugs.issue: LAPSED state not detected for manually-upgraded users. When a user is upgraded to paid tier via admin PATCH (without Stripe), and their tier_expires_at passes, the state returns FREE_NEVER_PAID instead of LAPSED because has_ever_paid logic only checks stripe_customer_id and stripe_subscription_id fields.
medium_priority_bugs.impact: Users who were manually upgraded by admin won't see the correct 'LAPSED' state message. They'll see 'FREE_NEVER_PAID' instead, which is confusing since they did have paid access before.
medium_priority_bugs.suggested_fix: Add additional check in has_ever_paid logic: if tier_expires_at exists and is in the past, consider has_ever_paid=True. Or track a separate 'has_had_paid_tier' boolean field on user document.
medium_priority_bugs.workaround: For testing with real Stripe subscriptions, this won't be an issue. Only affects manually-upgraded test users.

passed_tests: GET /api/billing/status as FREE_NEVER_PAID user (admin) - Returns correct state, can_open_portal=false, certificates_count=0
GET /api/billing/status as paid user (sage1) - Returns state=ACTIVE_RENEWING, tier=sage, interval=annual, certificates_count field present
GET /api/billing/status includes certificates_count field (integer >= 0) in all cases
POST /api/billing/resume without active stripe_subscription_id - Returns 400 'No active subscription to resume'
Certificate persistence after tier lapse - GET /api/certificates still returns all certs for lapsed user (no tier gate)
GET /api/certificates/{id} as lapsed user - Still returns the certificate
GET /api/certificates/public/{id} - Still works for public access
Tier auto-downgrade on expiry - tier_expires_at in past triggers downgrade to 'free' tier
Regression: POST /api/billing/portal still works (returns 400 for users without stripe_customer_id)
Regression: POST /api/billing/checkout endpoint exists and responds correctly
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix LAPSED state detection logic in GET /api/billing/status (line 1767 in server.py). The has_ever_paid check should also consider users who had tier_expires_at set (indicating they had paid access at some point), not just users with Stripe IDs. Suggested fix: has_ever_paid = bool(cust_id) or bool(fresh.get('stripe_subscription_id')) or bool(fresh.get('tier_expires_at')). This ensures manually-upgraded users (common in testing/admin scenarios) show LAPSED instead of FREE_NEVER_PAID when their access expires.

additional_notes.certificate_persistence: ✅ VERIFIED - Certificates remain accessible after tier lapse. No tier gate on /api/certificates endpoints. This is the most critical requirement and it works correctly.
additional_notes.state_machine: 4 of 5 states tested successfully: FREE_NEVER_PAID ✅, ACTIVE_RENEWING ✅, LAPSED ⚠️ (logic issue), PAST_DUE (not tested - requires Stripe webhook), ACTIVE_CANCELING (not tested - requires cancel_at_period_end=true)
additional_notes.testing_limitations: Cannot fully test PAST_DUE and ACTIVE_CANCELING states without real Stripe subscription data. These states require actual Stripe webhooks or subscription modifications.
additional_notes.phase_15_unrelated_failure: One test failure in Phase 15 (draft edit after rejection) is unrelated to Phase 17 and was pre-existing.
